name: Notepad++
summary: Installs and runs perfectly through Wine, including plugins, themes and 'Open with' from the file manager.
notes:
Notepad++ (the free source-code editor) works out of the box through Wine: syntax highlighting, macros, plugins (Plugin Admin downloads work), themes, session restore, find in files, and drag-and-drop from Thunar. Use the 64-bit installer (npp.x.y.z.Installer.x64.exe) - a plain NSIS installer that needs no extra runtimes; the portable ZIP also works (unzip and run notepad++.exe with lindos-run).
After the installer finishes Lindos adds 'Notepad++' to the Start Menu (Wine) and to Lindos Settings > Windows apps. To open text files with it by default: right-click a file in the file manager > Open With > Notepad++. Its own auto-updater (WinGUp) works, or just run the newer installer with the same command.
The only known differences: the Windows shell 'Edit with Notepad++' context-menu entry is not added (Linux file managers use the Start Menu entry instead), and dark-mode follows Wine's window theme, not the Lindos theme.
Native alternatives on Lindos: Mousepad (pre-installed), Geany, VS Code / VSCodium, Kate.
